description:
**These changes are now available in [4.105.0](https://github.com/vapor/vapor/releases/tag/4.105.0)**


* Drop support for Swift 5.7
* Fix warnings in Vapor with latest Swift 6 changes
* Fix tests on Linux nightlies

comments.body: Should we make a ticket for this and link it here?
It's fixed in the 6.0 branch, just waiting on a release
Interesting that the API checker is flagging this as different — the parentheses are implied in the same spot on the old version, aren't they?
Yeah but I don't think the API checker is clever enough to work that out
